##### Project general facts

Binghatti Hillside is a contemporary residential development defined by its striking architectural presence and a design philosophy that balances modern aesthetics with a sense of tranquility. The building features a distinctive silhouette with clean lines and sculptural elements, reflecting Binghatti’s signature approach to urban design. Residences are thoughtfully planned with spacious layouts, natural light, and refined detailing, creating a harmonious living environment that blends elegance with everyday functionality.

Residents benefit from a curated selection of amenities designed to support wellness, relaxation, and community living. The development includes an adults’ swimming pool, a children’s pool and play area, a half basketball court, and landscaped poolside spaces with sunken seating. Concierge services and carefully designed communal areas further enhance the residential experience, offering comfort, convenience, and a calm, lifestyle-oriented atmosphere.

Interiors are finished with refined materials, including marble, brass, wood, and specialty porcelain, creating a sophisticated and contemporary aesthetic. Apartments feature equipped kitchens, ensuring practicality and ease of use for daily living. Units are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their interiors while benefiting from high-quality finishes and a well-designed architectural foundation.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Barsha South is a thriving residential district in Dubai known for its strategic location, tranquil environment, and growing popularity among families and professionals. Nestled between key arterial roads like Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Umm Suqeim Street, the area offers excellent connectivity to major parts of the city, including Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, and the airport. Its peaceful atmosphere, combined with convenient access, makes it an ideal address for balanced urban living.

The neighborhood is home to a wide selection of modern apartment buildings, villas, and townhouses, catering to diverse lifestyle needs. With a number of schools, clinics, supermarkets, and parks nearby, Al Barsha South supports a family-friendly lifestyle that emphasizes comfort, safety, and accessibility. The district also benefits from proximity to renowned healthcare hubs such as Dubai Science Park and Mediclinic Parkview Hospital.

As one of Dubai’s emerging communities, Al Barsha South is quickly transforming into a well-rounded destination that blends city vibrancy with residential calm. Its steady development, focus on livability, and availability of new high-quality real estate projects continue to attract investors and end-users alike, establishing it as a sought-after address in the heart of new Dubai.
